children: Reliance Industries Ltd Sponsored GDR 144A (NSE:RELIANCE) reported record Q2 FY27 profit of Rs.29,550 crore, up 33.8% year over year, as revenue rose 27.8% to Rs.3,62,268 crore. The company also signed an MoU with Andhra Pradesh for an underground coal gasification project with phased investment of about ₹43,000 crore, subject to trials and approvals.
: Reliance Industries reported record Q2 FY27 profit of Rs.29,550 crore, up 33.8% year over year. Revenue rose 27.8% to Rs.3,62,268 crore and EBITDA gained 23.9% to Rs.62,409 crore.
: Reliance Industries signed an MoU with Andhra Pradesh for an underground coal gasification project, with phased investment of about ₹43,000 crore subject to successful trials and approvals.
: Reliance Industries’ sponsored GDR was awarded two coal blocks in Andhra Pradesh’s Eluru district. The state development board is expected to coordinate support for land, water and power access.
: RELIANCE rose 15% through Nov. 13, closing at Rs.1,339 and adding Rs.2,37,767 crore to its market value. Shares gained after the company reported September-quarter results on Oct. 30.
: Reliance Industries’ separate 10GWh PLI-ACC allocation has not been extended. The project runs through July 2027, with incentives scheduled until 2032.
: Reliance Jio added 7.7 million mobile subscribers in Q2FY27, up from 7.3 million in Q1FY27. Figures exclude home broadband and include machine-to-machine and IoT SIMs.
: Reliance Industries, ONGC and BP are discussing a proposed $1 billion shared offshore facility in the Mahanadi basin to process and ship gas and condensate. Plans remain at an early stage.

title: Weekly Recap: Record Q2 profit and Andhra Pradesh gasification MoU
